text:
Maria F.: Quick flag 1: GCP invoice shows duplicate GPU line items for project `customer-pilot-phi` leading to +$6,200 on Apr cycle; attaching invoice snippet and export.
CostBot: Invoice file uploaded: s3://billing/2026/04/INV-2026-04-22-phi-dup.csv
Nora T.: Hmm that looks like the double-billing SKU bug we've seen before. Pinging @Alex B. to surface to GCP billing.
Alex B.: Ran `gcloud beta billing accounts invoices describe BA-3344 --invoice-id=INV-2026-04-22` and I see two identical usage lines with the same usageStartTime. Opening vendor ticket GCP-4872 with logs. Link: https://gcp.support/tickets/GCP-4872
Priya S.: From finance POV we need to decide allocation: is this customer-billable (credit back to customer) or internal platform cost? Maria, can you map the invoice lines to resource tags/usage logs?
Maria F.: Mapping done 1: about 70% of hours tie to instances with tag `pilot/phi`, remainder are platform orchestration. Spreadsheet: sheets://finance/allocations/phi-apr2026 (attached). Proposing split: 70% ($4,340) refunded to customer invoice, 30% ($1,860) charged to platform budget.
CostBot: Cost allocation sheet created: sheets://finance/allocations/phi-apr2026
Nora T.: GCP acknowledged duplicate-line report and issued a provisional credit estimate; vendor says final adjustment in ~7 business days.
Alex B.: Vendor ticket ID GCP-4872, status: acknowledged, next update in 3 days. Recommend provisional accounting entry until vendor confirms.
Priya S.: Finance policy note: we can provisionally issue customer credit up to $5k with manager sign-off. Requesting approval for $4,340 provisional credit to the pilot customer's invoice. @Sam G. FYI.
Sam G.: Approved provisional credit $4,340 (REF-PROT-1784951234). Finance to record contra entry and note vendor ticket. Final reconciliation after vendor confirmation.
Maria F.: I'll apply provisional credit and add ledger line. Will update thread when vendor posts final adjustment. :white_check_mark:
CostBot: Alert created: "duplicate-gpu-line-detection" -> routing to #finance,#eng-billing and creating TICKET-FIN-9043
Maria F.: Leaving this thread as the audit trail for the provisional allocation and vendor ticket. Thanks all. :pray:
